string.name: perm_camera
string.value: Used to take on-site evidence photos and videos. Captures are kept inside the app and are not written to your system album.

string.name: perm_microphone
string.value: Used to record on-site audio evidence and to capture sound while recording video. Recordings are kept only as evidence records.

string.name: perm_location
string.value: Used to record where each photo or video was taken, as part of its archive details. Location is read once per capture and never tracked in the background.

string.name: perm_background
string.value: Used to keep recording after you tap Start and switch away or lock the screen. Recording ends when you tap Stop.
